origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model gemini-2.5-pro: the relay answers 503 and the tier below has no account in service, so the relay's failure is the request's. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
